The Strapi Users and Permissions API provides a full authentication process based on JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to protect API endpoints, along with an access-control list (ACL) strategy for managing permissions between groups of users. It supports user registration, login, password reset, email confirmation, and social provider authentication workflows. End users and their account information are managed as a content-type, and the API enables configuration of roles and permissions to control which API endpoints are accessible to authenticated and public users.
